path_decisions.rationale: profit_target_exit() is LONG-only (no direction param) and directly interacts with trailing stop state machine — fixing direction awareness in profit_target is prerequisite for trailing stop to work correctly on short positions

vol_breakout min_conditions=5 nearly impossible (all 5 conditions required simultaneously), mean_rev min=2 with vol_ok~always True — both inflate entries with weak signals that drag win rate; also profit_target default values are 2-3x lower than YAML intends due to key mismatch

BacktestEngine has 1-bar exit timing lag (signal bar N executes bar N+1) plus long-only limitation — both distort measured win rate and mask all short-side bugs including trailing stop and profit target failures

evidence: trend_following.py:281-292: trailing stop tracks highest CLOSE only, no lowest tracking for shorts
volatility_breakout.py:385-396: identical trailing stop bug — tracks highest only despite entries including short signals (line 372)
_runtime.py:131-173: profit_target_exit() has no direction parameter — line 167 target_price = entry_price * (1.0 + profit_take_pct) LONG-only
_runtime.py:169: close >= target_price only checks upward, never close <= entry_price * (1 - pct) for shorts
trend_following.py:260-265: RSI-adaptive uses rsi[entries].mean() (global average) not per-entry RSI — with 100+ entries converges to ~50, making feature dead code
trend_following.py:56: code reads trailing_stop_atr_mult (default 3.0) but YAML line 25 has trailing_stop_atr_multiplier: 1.5 — key mismatch makes YAML value dead letter
volatility_breakout.py:51: code default trailing_stop_atr_mult=2.5 vs YAML trailing_stop_atr_multiplier: 2.0 — another key mismatch
mean_reversion.py:36: volume_threshold code default=0.8 (nearly always True) vs YAML volume_threshold: 1.2 — vol_ok trivially satisfied, effective min_conditions=1 of 2
volatility_breakout.py:48: min_conditions=5 requires ALL 5 conditions simultaneously — nearly impossible to trigger, zero entries in most periods
backtest.py:112-117: entry_values[prev_idx] at bar N executes at close_values[i] (bar N+1) — 1-bar lag on both entry and exit
elliott_wave.py:70-74: on_bar() is empty — no trailing stop, no profit target, no max_holding in live/paper path

candidate_solution.summary: 7 concrete code fixes across 4 bottleneck clusters that collectively block win rate improvement: (1) add direction awareness to profit_target_exit + trailing stop, (2) fix YAML-to-code key bridge, (3) calibrate min_conditions and volume_threshold, (4) address backtest timing lag

fix_1_direction_aware_profit_target.change: Add direction parameter to profit_target_exit(). For SHORT: target_price = entry_price * (1.0 - profit_take_pct), exit when close <= target_price. Propagate direction from all 6 strategy callers.
fix_1_direction_aware_profit_target.impact: CRITICAL — currently short positions never hit profit target, run to max_holding timeout at lower profit or outright loss

fix_2_direction_aware_trailing_stop.change: Add direction tracking to trailing stop state machine. For LONG entries: track highest HIGH (not CLOSE). For SHORT entries: track lowest LOW. trailing_exits for long = close < highest - atr*mult. trailing_exits for short = close > lowest + atr*mult.
fix_2_direction_aware_trailing_stop.impact: HIGH — trailing stop currently only protects longs; short positions have zero trailing stop protection, plus CLOSE tracking causes premature exits on valid pullbacks

fix_3_trailing_stop_for_remaining_4_stra.change: Add trailing stop logic to generate_signals() for all 4 strategies that currently lack it. Use same ATR-based pattern from trend_following but with per-strategy multipliers from YAML (mean_rev: trailing_stop_pct 0.02, elliott: atr_stop_mult 1.5, funding: stop_loss_pct -0.03, momentum: stop_loss_pct 0.03).
fix_3_trailing_stop_for_remaining_4_stra.impact: HIGH — 4/6 strategies have zero trailing stop, losing trades can run unbounded

fix_4_yaml_code_key_bridge.change: Add YAML key aliases in __init__: p.get('take_profit_pct', p.get('profit_take_pct', 0.10)), p.get('trailing_stop_atr_multiplier', p.get('trailing_stop_atr_mult', 3.0)), p.get('stop_loss_pct', 0.0). This bridges YAML→code name gap making YAML values effective.
fix_4_yaml_code_key_bridge.impact: HIGH — current YAML values are dead letters; profit targets 2-3x lower than intended, trailing stop 2x wider than intended

fix_5_rsi_adaptive_per_entry.change: Replace global rsi[entries].mean() with per-entry RSI tracking. In the position-tracking loop, record rsi_at_entry when entry fires, and use that per-trade RSI to compute effective_pct for each trade individually.
fix_5_rsi_adaptive_per_entry.impact: MEDIUM — RSI-adaptive feature currently dead code (global mean ~50 always); per-entry RSI would tighten targets for overbought entries and widen for oversold

fix_6_min_conditions_calibration.change: volatility_breakout: reduce min_conditions from 5 to 3 (ATR spike + bb_expanding + (close breakout OR squeeze) is sufficient). mean_reversion: increase effective min_conditions by raising volume_threshold default from 0.8 to 1.2 (matching YAML). This filters weak entries.
fix_6_min_conditions_calibration.impact: MEDIUM — vol_breakout currently generates near-zero entries; mean_rev allows 1-of-2 entries with trivially-satisfied vol_ok

fix_7_on_bar_exit_awareness.change: Add profit_target, trailing stop, and max_holding_bars checks to on_bar() path for all 4 strategies. Currently on_bar only uses _latest_signal() which lacks these exits — live/paper positions can run indefinitely.
fix_7_on_bar_exit_awareness.impact: HIGH — on_bar is the live/paper path; without these exits, positions held in production have no systematic exit mechanism beyond manual intervention

interaction_effects.profit_target_vs_trailing_stop: Both OR into exits — no conflict when both fire same bar. But trailing stop state machine resets in_pos on profit_exits, so if profit_target exits, trailing stop correctly stops tracking. CORRECT interaction.
interaction_effects.max_holding_override: max_holding_bars is implemented inside profit_target_exit() (_runtime.py:169). It forces exit regardless of trailing stop. CORRECT — max_holding is safety timeout that should override.
interaction_effects.backtest_timing_distortion: 1-bar lag (backtest.py:112-117) means trailing stop exit at bar N executes at bar N+1 close. Price gap can make realized exit significantly worse than signaled exit. Estimated 2-4% win rate penalty from this alone.

notes: Iteration 3 deeper analysis confirms and extends iter2 findings. NEW findings beyond iter2: (1) elliott_wave, funding_rate, momentum_rotation have ZERO trailing stop — not just incomplete but absent, (2) trailing stop direction loss is worse than reported — vol_breakout entries include both long AND short signals (line 372) but trailing only tracks highest, (3) on_bar() path in 4 strategies lacks ALL exit mechanisms (profit_target, trailing stop, max_holding), (4) YAML key bridge affects ALL 6 strategies not just 3 — funding_rate and momentum_rotation also have take_profit_pct vs profit_take_pct mismatch, (5) RSI-adaptive profit target uses global mean not per-entry RSI (ANT-2-2 found this but impact is larger than estimated — with 100+ entries the mean converges to ~50 making the feature completely dead). Total estimated win rate impact if all 7 fixes applied: +15-25% (on top of iter1+2 fixes).
